title: Nano's Item Pedestals
description: Adds customizable item pedestals to Vanilla Minecraft!
body:
This plugin adds customizable item pedestals to vanilla minecraft, **no resourcepack needed!**

To make a pedestal, simply place any 2 blocks you think would go well together on top of each other, then right click the bottom one with an item frame that has been named "**Pedestal**" in an anvil.

Since you can use **any 2 blocks**, there are in theory **over a million different item pedestal variations!**

Here are just a few of them: (Thank you to [SuperSaiMC](https://www.twitch.tv/supersaimc_live) for helping me come up with some variants)
![A banner showcasing just a few of the possible pedestal variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36ac8ca8cc6711c22b04434fef4049ada8f431e4.png)
Requires [NanoUtils](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nanoutils)
